TEMPLATE swipes{
	TouchAreaSwipeFilter{
		id: ~{id}~
		property bool ~{conditionName}~ : ~{condition}~
		distance: ~{distance}~* touchArea.pixelsPerCm
		direction: ~{direction}~
        enabled: !touchArea.panAndZoomOnly
	releaseRequired: ~{releaseRequired}~
		area: ~{areas}~
		fingers: ~{fingers}~
		onTriggered:~{action}~
	}

} 
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/SceneViewGestures.qml
	TRAVERSE TouchArea
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT SLOT gestureSlots
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
